units.source_text: 先说说这时候的洛阳，这里是繁荣昌盛、天下第一的大都会，人车往来，川流不息。

en.t: First, let us speak of Luoyang at that time. It was a great metropolis, prosperous and flourishing, the finest under heaven, with people and carriages passing back and forth in an endless stream.

units.source_text: 夕阳西下，暮光就像美丽的油彩一般洒在城门之上，

en.t: As the evening sun sank in the west, the twilight spilled over the city gate like beautiful oil paint,

units.source_text: 过往的行人来来往往，戴着纱帽的老人家，带着金环的土耳其姑娘、拴着五彩缰绳的白马，

en.t: with passersby coming and going, old men wearing gauze caps, Turkish girls wearing gold rings, and white horses tied with brightly colored reins,

units.source_text: 这个场景如梦似幻，美丽动人。

en.t: the scene was dreamlike and enchanting, beautiful enough to move the heart.
